app-title: Xarunta Waxbarashada ee Africa Pioneers - Dibadda
welcome-sub: Albaabka lagu Xoojinayo Afrika iyadoo la marayo Pi Ecosystem
africa-day: (Xuska Maalinta Afrika ee 25aad, Barnaamijkan Tababarka ee Pi Pioneers ayaa la bilaabay)
memorial-title: 🕊️ Xusuusta Jacaylka ee Christina Muzheki Manjengwa
memorial-text:
Xaruntan Waxbarasho waxaa loo hibeeyay walaashay ka weyn ee aan jeclahay Christina Muzheki Manjengwa oo nasatay 8da Agoosto 2026 laguna aasay 11ka Agoosto iyadoo ah Fasaxa Geesiyaasha Zimbabwe.
Jacaylkaaga, hagahaaga iyo xooggaaga ayaa sii dhiirigeliya himiladeena xoojinta Afrika.
Welige qalbiyadeenna. Ku naso xoog, Walaal.
intro-p1: Pi Network waa lacag dijital ah iyo mashruuc nidaam deegaan caalami ah oo loo qaabeey in cryptocurrency la heli karo oo waxtar u leh qof kasta.
intro-p2: Si ka duwan cryptocurrencies dhaqameed ee u baahan mashiinada macdanta qaali ah, Pi Network wuxuu u ogolaanayaa dadka caadiga ah inay si toos ah uga qayb galaan taleefanooda.
intro-p3: Waa maxay sababta Pi loogu talagalay Afrika?
intro-list:
• Dhisa dhaqaale dijital ah oo loo dhan yahay aan lahayn bangi
  • Xoojiya dadka caadiga ah ee aduunka oo dhan macdanta taleefanka
  • Kordhi isticmaalka dhabta ah iyada oo loo marayo utilities iyo DApps
  • Taageer ganacsiga qof-ka-qof oo yaree khidmadaha
  • Waxaa abuuray Stanford PhDs - Dr Nicolas Kokkalis & Dr Chengdiao Fan
  • In ka badan 60 Milyan oo Pioneers ah adduunka oo dhan
ch1-p1: Tallaabada 1: Soo deji Pi Network - Isticmaal xiriirka: minepi.com/chigalex1
ch1-p2: Tallaabada 2: Iska diiwaan geli Facebook ama Taleefan → Geli koodhka: CHIGALEX1 → Hel abaalmarin 1 Pi
ch1-p3: Macdanta Maalinlaha: Ku soo noqo 24 saacadood kasta oo guji badhanka hillaaca si aad u sii wadato macdanta.
ch1-p4: Khaladaadka Caadiga ah ee Laga Fogaado:
ch1-list2:
• Ha isticmaalin magac been ah - waa inuu la mid noqdaa ID-ga KYC
  • Ha abuurin akoonyo badan - hal qof hal akoon
  • Deji alaarmiga macdanta 24 saacadood kasta si aad u ilaaliso heerka
  • Ku biir wareegga amniga 3 maalmood ka dib 5 qof oo aad aaminsan tahay
ch1-list:
• Abuur boorsada Pi si ammaan ah
  • Dhamee 2FA
  • Dhamee KYC
  • U diyaari guuritaanka Mainnet
security-msg: ⚠️ Ammaanka boorsada: WALIGAA ha wadaagin 24 kelmadood sirta ah! Kooxda Pi Core WALIGEE ma ku weydiin doonto!
ch2-p1: Boorsada Pi-gaaga waa bangigaaga ku jira Pi Ecosystem. Waxay ku haysaa qadaadiicda Pi-gaaga si ammaan ah blockchain-ka.
ch2-p2: Sida loo abuuro: Fur Pi Browser → Wallet → Abuur Wallet → KOOBIYEE 24 kelmadood → Ku kaydi offline 2 meelood oo ammaan ah.
ch2-p3: Qaadashada Pi: La wadaag ciwaankaaga dadweynaha (ku bilowda G...). Diritaanka Pi: Dheji ciwaanka qaataha, geli qaddarka, xaqiiji.
ch2-list:
• Ku qor passphrase warqad, ma aha shaashad
  • Ku kaydi 2 meelood oo ammaan ah oo kala duwan (ma aha taleefanka kaliya)
  • Ku tijaabi 1 Pi ka hor intaadan dirin qaddar weyn
  • Hubi 4ta hore iyo 4ta dambe ee ciwaanka mar walba
ch2a-p1: Ficil: Ku bilow qadar yar oo tijaabo ah (1 Pi). Xaqiiji 4-ta hore iyo 4-ta dambe ee ciwaanka inay isku mid yihiin. Waligaa ha ku dhejin passphrase-kaaga mareeg kasta!
ch2a-p2: Jimicsi Toos ah: Tababarkan, waxaan ku samayn doonaa bandhig toos ah oo diritaanka 1 Pi loo dirayo pioneer kale si loo dhiso kalsooni. Xusuusnow: Macaamilka Blockchain lama noqon karo!
